 Print Ibrahim Ali talks about how Kareena Kapoor is the 'coolest stepmother ever', while the actress talks about the bond he shares with Taimur and Jehangir. (Instagram) Ibrahim Ali, who has followed in his father’s footsteps and entered the Bollywood industry recently, shared a look into the warm bond that he shares with his stepmother, Kareena Kapoor . During a video segment on ‘ Koffee with Karan ,' he and his sister, Sara Ali Khan, appeared and sent their love and warm wishes to Saif and Kareena, who appeared together on the show as guests. While he described Kareena as the “coolest stepmother ever,” Saif added, “I credit everyone, because these things work both ways. And, of course, Kareena makes it easy and is wonderful with Sara and Ibrahim. And they also make an effort and reciprocate.” Watch IIFA 2027 Press Conference: Salman Khan’s Fan Moment, Kareena-Shahid Reunion & More Viral Highlights Kareena Kapoor talks about the bond Ibrahim Ali has with his step-siblings Taimur and Jehangir
 The ‘Jab We Met’ actress also commented on the bond Ibrahim shares with her sons, Taimur and Jehangir. She shared on the show, "Tim and Jeh also, they love Ibrahim; they really look up to him. And he's also amazing with them, while Saif Ali Khan also weighed in on the topic. He added, “Sometimes he comes over and goes to their room and asks them about things. He has his own equation with Jeh and asks him questions about stuff. I noticed that, and I just think he's a lovely boy for having that equation.” About Kareena Kapoor and Saif Ali Khan
 Kareena Kapoor Khan and Saif Ali Khan started dating in 2007, married in 2012, and welcomed two sons together. They met in 2003 while they were filming their film, ‘LOC Kargil,' though at the time they did not start dating. In 2006, they once again starred together in ‘Omkara.’ A year later, while filming for ‘Tashan’ in Ladakh, the two started dating and held a private wedding ceremony in 2012. The couple welcomed their first son, Taimur Ali Khan Pataudi, on December 20, 2016, and welcomed their second son, Jehangir (Jeh) Ali Khan, in February 2021. Last month, the two also celebrated their 14th anniversary together. Prior to Kapoor, Saif was married to Amrita Singh. The two tied the knot in January 1991 and filed for divorce in 2004.
